parsed.rationale: Both `NowPlayingItem` (AppServices, `Shared/AppServices/Sources/AppServices/NowPlayingService.swift:23`) and `PlaycutSelection` (app:iOS, `WXYC/iOS/Views/Playlist/PlaylistView.swift:23`) are `type-alias-object` records sharing two fields — `playcut:Playcut` and an artwork field — differing only in the concrete image type (`Image?` vs `UIImage?`). This is a textbook PAT opportunity: the shared structure is `playcut:Playcut` plus an artwork image whose concrete type varies by platform/layer. Introducing a `PlaycutDisplayable` protocol with `associatedtype ArtworkImage` and required members `playcut: Playcut` and `artwork: ArtworkImage?` lets both types conform without collapsing the platform-specific image type distinction, while making the shared shape explicit and checkable by the compiler. Neither record carries any restraint marker (`is_test`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app` are all false), so the action signal is unobstructed.
